caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned centrally within a light square border on an off-white background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of translucent blue-green, with a rounded body, a flared lip with a pouring spout, and a thick, curved handle that is attached to the side opposite the spout. The pitcher is outlined with fine lines, and subtle shading is used to indicate its transparency and the way light interacts with the glass. In the upper right corner of the square border, there is a small inset line drawing of a hand grasping an object, possibly the handle of the pitcher. The artist's name, "Michael Miceli," appears written in small lettering near the lower right edge of the squared border.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
